datasets.title: One request, from 2K to 8K
datasets.intro: How long does one complete prompt take to read, and how quickly are 128 new tokens written? These four points use exact prefixes of I promessi sposi.
conditions: Fresh complete prompt at each point · chunk 2K
Greedy AR · 128 output tokens · no warmup
Core inference only · model loading and HTTP excluded
datasets.caveat: One measured sample per point; no variability estimate. These are not the repeated-counting measurements shown in Long context.

datasets.title: Full-prompt context, through 128K
datasets.intro: Each point starts with an empty sequence and reads every prompt token before generating 128 tokens. Choose the prefill chunk size to see how the same Q2 weights behave as the prompt grows.
conditions: Original Q2 weights · Strix Halo/gfx1151 · IOMMU on
Repeated counting chat, not I promessi sposi
One warmup + one measured pass per point · greedy AR
datasets.caveat: The repeated counting text is a controlled diagnostic. It is separate from the literary-prompt multi-user run; do not rank their rates as matched runs. Matching continuations here do not establish broad model quality.

datasets.title: UD-Q4 full-prompt context, through 128K
datasets.intro: This is the UD-Q4_K_XL control from the same repeated-counting campaign. Each measured point starts empty, reads the whole prompt and then generates 128 tokens.
conditions: Original UD-Q4_K_XL weights · Strix Halo/gfx1151 · IOMMU on
Repeated counting chat · exact same physical prompts as Q2
2K chunks · one warmup + one measured pass · greedy AR
datasets.caveat: This is one measured pass per point. The Q2 and UD continuations matched on these prompts, but that alone is not a broad quality or performance qualification.

datasets.title: Several users, one GPU owner
datasets.intro: Every user in a group receives the same complete literary prompt. Prompt reading is serialized; ready users generate together in native batches.
conditions: Original Q2 weights · Strix Halo/gfx1151 · IOMMU off
Exact 2K/4K/6K/8K prefixes of I promessi sposi
One run per arm · no warmup · 128 outputs per user
Core inference only · model loading and HTTP excluded
datasets.caveat: C1 matches the saved single-user reference. C2–C8 agree with each other but produce different continuations from C1, so batch output equivalence is not qualified.
